The payment schedule shall be by five (5) instalments of US$220,000 each. The first instalment will be effect on condition that [PARTY_C] can raise at least US$1.1 million additional funding in 2002.
findings.explanation: The contract mandates large fixed installment payments totaling $1.1 million regardless of whether the distributed Content actually generates revenue or commercial success.
findings.suggested_change: Amend the payment terms to a revenue-sharing model where payments are a percentage of actual revenues generated from the Content, or tie installments to verifiable commercial milestones.

findings.quoted_text: Each Party agrees, at its own expense, to take any further action and to execute any further documents or instruments as the other Party may reasonably request to give effect to the transactions contemplated by, and to the terms of, this Agreement.
findings.explanation: This creates an open-ended obligation for [PARTY_C] to undertake future actions and execute documents at its own expense upon request, which could result in unanticipated administrative and financial burdens.
findings.suggested_change: Limit further assurances to those strictly necessary to formalize the agreed-upon terms, and specify that any requested amendments or additional documentation required by changes in law will be negotiated mutually.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are well. Thank you for sharing the agreement. Before moving forward, I would like to suggest a couple of changes: - Regarding the payment terms, the agreement requires fixed installment payments regardless of actual revenue generation, and I propose amending the terms to a revenue-sharing model or tying installments to verifiable commercial milestones. - Regarding future cooperation, the relevant clause creates an open-ended obligation to execute documents at one's own expense, and I propose limiting further assurances to those strictly necessary to formalize the agreed-upon terms. Please let me know if these modifications are acceptable. Best regards,
